title: fix(security): the subprocess environment guard accepts GH_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT_URL, which sends gh telemetry to a caller URL
summary: The plan of this case is the merged plan of pull request #2859, which the evaluation of 2026-11-01 judged acceptable, with one path corrected: `tests/test_process_env.py` is `tests/core/test_subprocess_env_gh_kubectl.py`. It has no known defect.
